sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Life - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "So, ready to keep getting familiar with the classes? Like you really have a choice... Pick your gear, grab a weapon, and get back to the Arena to smash some opponents!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 10 enemies as Scout or Marksman

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- 10 GP coins
- 44,000 Roubles
- Unlocks MSA Sordin Supreme PRO-X/L headset in the Armory
- Unlocks Solid Tan weapon camouflage
